title: GLM-5.2 Europe H200 PP8 one-token prefill replay — completed-prefix analysis
classification: valid analysis of 4,810 completed requests from a partial run; not a completed 55-minute benchmark

run.initial_cache_state: verified empty immediately before formal replay; radix/device and HiCache-host flush acknowledged once by every PP rank

last_ten_complete_minute_bins.definition: UTC-aligned bins ending 06:14 through 06:23; excludes the first ramp and final partial bin

internal_ttft.definition: prefill_finished_time - forward_entry_time; excludes the SGLang scheduler queue

descriptive_ols_internal_ttft_seconds.interpretation: empirical association in this trace; not a causal model

semantics.counter_source_reconstruction: The first cached-token series is device. The second series, which first appears when positive, is host; L3 was disabled.
semantics.request_window_assignment: Each valid prompt-token counter exactly matches one unique prefix sum of request completions in server finish-log order.
semantics.attribution_boundary: The scrape interval identifies the exact completed-request set and aggregate L2 tokens, but usually not the individual split among requests.

integrity.privacy: The public L2 attribution includes request ordinals, cached-token counts, reporting-window times, bounds, and the report's pre-existing SHA-256 evidence digests only. No request IDs, prompts, messages, request bodies, headers, response text, output IDs, or source identities are included.
